## Safety checklist

- [ ] No raw/restricted data, answers, credentials, checkpoints, or prediction exports
- [ ] No machine-specific absolute paths or private identifiers
- [ ] Split, preprocessing, or label changes include regression coverage
- [ ] Performance claims distinguish grouped validation from fitted references
- [ ] Documentation and visuals match the implemented behavior
